# `aitbc operations agent deregister`

Deregister an agent by its ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations agent deregister [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | The Agent id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations agent deregister --agent-id <agent_id>
```
